verdict.rationale: Netlify is an edge and serverless hosting platform, so offering a persistent agent runtime is a fair question. However, the evidence shows only serverless functions, Blobs storage, deploy rollbacks, and dashboard-prompted AI agents. Nothing documents a persistent runtime environment for a coding agent that checkpoints its state automatically. Deploy rollback and key/value storage are adjacent features, not agent-state checkpointing.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working
